text:
sophia: quick heads-up — ran cross-region latency sweep for Qwen-14B-32k, Mistral-7B, Llama-2-13B on h100/us-east vs a100/eu-west. seeing a weird step at 8k ctx where kernels fall back.

 dario: steps? logs?

 sophia: reqs per sec drops ~25% at seq>8k on a100 eu-west for Qwen. stack shows KernelAllocator falling back to generic aten path.

 anya: is that the rope/GQA only? or all attention types?

 sophia: looks tied to rope+GQA combo. Mistral fine, Llama shows minor hit but not full fallback.

 eli: did you try quant profiles? quant4a can change kernel selection

 sophia: ran float32 + quant4a + quant4_0. quant4_0 reduces memory so a100 stays on optimized path, but qual/regression in ppl for Qwen.

 benchbot: perf snapshot uploaded: link: https://internal.bench/reports/1960001111

 dario: can you paste the allocation stack? quick grep

 sophia: ```
 [WARN] KernelFallback: missing fused_rope_gqa_kernel for model=qwen_14b, arch=a100, seq=8192
 [INFO] Falling back to aten_causal_attn
 ```

 anya: aha. kernel naming mismatch between build for qwen-rope variants and deployed kernels.

 eli: which runtime build on eu-west a100? rtx-2026-06? different cuda minor could cause symbol mismatch

 sophia: eu-west runtime: inference-runtime v2.8.3+cudnn810, us-east h100: v2.8.7+cudnn820

 dario: that explains it. shipping newer kernel to eu-west should fix. but we should add a graceful quant fallback test in CI.

 sophia: yeah. next steps: (1) backport fused_rope_gqa kernel to r2.8.3 on eu-west, (2) run quant4_0 quality eval for Qwen-14B on 2k/8k/16k prompt slices, (3) update kernel-compat matrix in docs.

 eli: i'll open infra ticket for a100 patch and coord with releases.

 deploy-bot: ticket INFRA-834 created by eli: "backport fused_rope_gqa kernel to eu-west a100 fleet" :white_check_mark:

 anya: also add a perf alert when throughput delta >15% between regions for same build.

 sophia: agreed. assigned owners on the bench report. thanks everyone :rocket:
